direction: Create a polished fighting-game animation direction review sheet for HAMMER from the attached character reference. Preserve exact character identity: bald dark-skinned muscular adult man, confident stern face, cobalt scarf, cream tabard with crossed blue hammers, silver engraved shoulder/forearm/knee armor, black trousers, strapped brown boots, large heavy grey mason's hammer. Mature anime fighting game proportions, strong readable cel shaded anatomy, crisp black outlines, cream/silver/cobalt palette. NO new costume, no glowing magic armor, no body smearing. Landscape contact sheet: THREE horizontal rows, THREE full-body poses per row, nine total. Spacious clean warm grey background, all feet visible, all face RIGHT in consistent side gameplay view, keep identical body scale and hammer design across all nine drawings. Clear row headings A / SHOULDER DRIVE, B / LOW SKIP, C / PIVOT STEP. Column headings LOAD, DASH, STRIKE. Thin cobalt motion arrows BELOW each figure with a red curved arrow at hammer swing, labels never overlap figure. Each row is a distinct fluid explosive weight-transfer choreography for a single forward step dash canceled into a short hammer normal. A: upright compact boxer-like shoulder lead, compressed rear leg load, powerful forward single step trailing hammer then hip-led short horizontal hammer check. B: much lower sprint-start crouch, broad forward skimming step hammer held low behind, rising diagonal short hammer check. C: coiled torso with front foot planted, forward crossing/pivot step with hips unwinding, pivot-powered horizontal hammer snap with clear counterbalance. LOAD→DASH shows largest displacement; STRIKE is firm committed silhouette, planted support foot, arms guide hammer rather than disconnected flailing. Distinguish path and weight transfer, not just static hand poses. Show grounded mass, boots pushing floor, scarf lagging a beat, elastic anticipation and decisive stop. Minimal angular dust only; do not obscure limbs or weapon with effects. Row A strongest sturdy balanced stance; B aggressive low lean; C sophisticated rotational swagger. This is an options sheet, NOT final sprite atlas. Text only prescribed short headings, no logo.
